not_measured: OCR character error rate: needs a run with --ocr.
Form 3 field accuracy: there are no labelled FAIRs to score against yet.
Customer drawings: every number comes from synthetic drawings. Export-controlled samples are never evaluated or published.

live_extraction.matching: Truth and reads are paired by the revision matcher (diff_revisions); a pair that is unchanged or differs only in presentation is a correct read, a pair whose values differ is a misread and counts against precision and recall. Datum feature symbols are not scored.
